I plotted monthly revenue as a bar chart and opened it in your image viewer. It's also saved at `/tmp/acme-chart/monthly_revenue.png`.

Revenue rises from $41,200 in January to $71,800 in December, with small dips in February, June and October. I labelled only the first and last bars.

**December is in the future.** `data/sales.csv` has a 2026-12 row ($71,800), but today is 2026-11-28. That row is probably a forecast or placeholder, and November may be incomplete too. I plotted both as given. Tell me if you want December dropped or shown differently.

The plot script is `/tmp/acme-chart/plot.py`. I kept it outside the repo, so nothing in your project changed.
